breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and also periodic. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and resolved it by stating, 'Impose Dirichlet boundary conditions on all four edges only' and explicitly adding, 'Do not apply periodic boundary conditions,' which aligns with the ground truth.
